Kanhaiya Wadhawan to captain North Zone cricket team

Kanhaiya Wadhawan has been named captain of the North Zone cricket team. Arshdeep Singh is also included in the squad. Six cricketers from Jammu and Kashmir have been selected for the North Zone team.
